configuration_policy: Unmodified full defaults; only device, load path, save path and process thread limits are set. CPU and GPU use one identical CUDA-capable PyTorch 2.8 environment, the same package versions as the 1.3.4 records.
gpu_device_policy: Existing free MIG instance on GPU 0 (the instance used for the 1.3.4 records); no GPU reconfiguration or interruption of other jobs.
